decision: Eight exact reviewed clay models recommended for bounded local integration and subsequent browser acceptance.
scope: Fresh offline selection review of actual source/model phone comparisons, all-view inventory boards and one original-resolution contact render per selected candidate; exact GLB hashes and 214 available historical evidence hashes checked. selection_basis: The five library choices add two familiar detached-house forms, one contemporary infill form, one office shaft and one residential tower/podium to the three specified low-rise buildings. All eight are distinct from the 12 validation picker variants read at review start. Strong means practical clay identity, coverage and available exact-byte approval; no numerical quality ranking is claimed.
